subject: Renewal: amendment to include additional reserved GPUs & revised invoicing
messages:
From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Blake <a.blake@novafield.com>, procurement@novafield.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal conversation: adding reserved GPUs to upcoming term

Hi Aisha / NovaField procurement team,

Thanks for continuing the renewal dialog. Per our last demo and sizing exercise, NovaField is planning to expand your Dedicated pool by +12 A100-equivalent GPUs at next term start (2026-11-01). To keep billing aligned with your fiscal calendar, we recommend co-terming the expansion with your renewal and issuing a single PO amendment rather than a separate purchase order.

High-level proposal: 
- Add 12 GPUs to existing Reserved Pool (effective 2026-11-01)
- 12-month co-term to match renewal through 2027-10-31
- Throughput guarantee: sustained 1.2M tokens/minute for model family X (details in attached spreadsheet)
- Pricing: blended reserved rate (see attached breakdown)
- Billing: prorated charge for Nov + full monthly invoices thereafter; suggest invoicing cadence be: prorated upfront charge + monthly invoice on the 1st

I've attached a draft PO amendment and a pricing workbook for your procurement review. Ben from Escrow & Billing is cc'd to confirm preferred invoicing mechanics.

Next steps: if procurement confirms the billing cadence and PO language, we'll route the amendment for signature via DocuSign and push the capacity on 11/1. Can you confirm who will sign on NovaField's side and whether you require a separate SOW?

Thanks,
Grace
--
Grace Oconnor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0124
attachments: RWI_PO_Amendment_NVF_20261015.pdf (PDF), NVF_reserved-pool-pricing-breakdown-2026Q4.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Aisha Blake <a.blake@novafield.com>
To: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Leland <t.leland@novafield.com>, procurement@novafield.com
Date: 2026-09-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: adding reserved GPUs to upcoming term

Hi Grace,

Thanks — this looks straightforward. A few clarifying Qs from procurement and finance: 
1) We need an itemized price per GPU slot and the monthly recurring total (you attached an XLSX; please add a tab that maps the blended line to individual slots so our PMO can reconcile to the master budget).
2) On co-terming: finance prefers a single consolidated PO amendment and invoice schedule. Confirm you can do a prorated charge for Nov on one invoice and then monthly thereafter.
3) Signatory: I will sign the amendment (Chief Procurement Officer). Tom will loop in legal if any SLA language is changed.

Also — can you confirm whether the throughput guarantee you listed is contractual (SLA) or a performance target? We need to know remediation rights in case of sustained underrun.

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the revised spreadsheet.

Best,
Aisha
--
Aisha Blake
Head of Infrastructure Procurement, NovaField Therapeutics
a.blake@novafield.com

From: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Blake <a.blake@novafield.com>, procurement@novafield.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: adding reserved GPUs to upcoming term

Thanks Aisha — updated materials attached. Key clarifications: 
- Pricing workbook now includes a per-GPU monthly line and the blended reserved pool line; page "Procurement View" maps to your budget categories.
- Billing cadence: we will issue one invoice that includes the prorated period (2026-11-01 through 2026-11-30) and then monthly on the 1st for the remainder of the co-term. If you prefer quarterly invoices, we can accommodate — let Ben know.
- Throughput guarantee: we offer a contractual throughput SLO tied to the reserved configuration (sustained tokens/min baseline). The PO amendment includes an SLA clause with remedies (service credit tiers). If legal requests stronger financial penalties we can escalate to Sales Leadership for exceptions.

Attachments: updated PO amendment (tracks the SLA language), pricing workbook v2, invoice schedule draft.

If this matches procurement's requirements, I'll prepare the DocuSign flow and Marissa will send the final invoice schedule.

Grace
--
Grace Oconnor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
attachments: RWI_PO_Amendment_NVF_20261015.pdf, NVF_reserved-pool-pricing-breakdown-2026Q4.xlsx

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Blake <a.blake@novafield.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation: adding reserved GPUs to upcoming term

Hi Aisha — quick technical note on throughput + operations: 

- The sustained 1.2M tokens/min baseline assumes workload mix: 62% short completions (<64 tokens), 38% multi-turn chat (avg 320 tokens). If NovaField's usage skews heavier toward long-context inference, we may need to reconfigure the pool (different kernel selection / fewer concurrent streams) — that would affect sustained throughput guarantees.
- We include automated prefix/KV caching and intelligent batching as part of the reserved pool to preserve latency SLOs without sacrificing cost.
- Runbook: in case of sustained underrun, remediation is service credits as noted in the SLA. For operational transparency we'll enable per-route tracing for 90 days after provisioning.

Happy to join Tom/Legal call if you want to walk through technical remedy language.

Thanks,
Dev
--
Dev Patel
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@novafield.com, Aisha Blake <a.blake@novafield.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Invoice cadence and amended billing schedule for NVF reserved pool expansion

Hi Aisha / NovaField finance,

Per Grace's note and your preference to consolidate invoicing, attached is the proposed invoice schedule: 
- Invoice #1 (one-time prorated charge): covers 2026-11-01 through 2026-11-30 — due on receipt.
- Invoice #2 (monthly recurring): first monthly invoice issued 2026-12-01 covering 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-01, then monthly on the 1st.
- Billing format: CSV + PDF for AP ingestion (we can also provide a single-line GL mapping).

If you want quarterly invoicing or net-45 terms, please confirm by EOD 10/08 so we can lock the DocuSign and invoice pipeline. Once DocuSign is complete we'll provision the capacity on 11/01.

Attachments: invoice_schedule_NVF_Q4-2026.pdf

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: invoice_schedule_NVF_Q4-2026.pdf

From: procurement@novafield.com <procurement@novafield.com>
To: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Blake <a.blake@novafield.com>, Tom Leland <t.leland@novafield.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: amendment to include additional reserved GPUs & revised invoicing

Grace / team — confirmed. NovaField will sign the consolidated PO amendment. We will: 
1) Issue a single PO amendment (PO #NVF-PO-7942) that covers the 12-GPU top-up co-termed with the renewal.
2) Sign via DocuSign (link received) — signature expected by 10/20.
3) AP requests Net-30 on the first monthly invoice but will pay the prorated upfront invoice on receipt. If that creates a timing gap, please flag and we can cadence differently.

Tom (legal) wants a short call to review the SLA credit table — available 10/18 09:00-10:00 PT if you can join.

We will send the PO PDF to you once it's approved internally.

procurement@novafield.com
--
NovaField Therapeutics — Procurement Team
body_preview: Grace: drafted PO amendment to add 12 GPUs, co-term with renewal. Aisha: asks for itemization and SLA clarity. Marissa: invoice schedule attached. Procurement: confirmed PO and DocuSign timeline.
